sec-head.h2: What does an AI agent developer do?

p: An AI agent developer designs and builds autonomous agent systems: architectures that orchestrate LLMs, tools, and memory to execute complex, multi-step tasks. This includes framework selection (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), tool integration, state management, guardrails, observability, and production deployment. A freelance AI agent developer delivers a functioning, production-ready system with a proven delivery record, not just a framework demo.

sec-head.h2: AI agent developer vs LLM engineer vs AI engineer

td: Autonomous agent architecture, framework implementation, tool orchestration, and state management
You need a system that plans, executes, and adapts across multiple steps using your tools and data
You need to customize model behavior itself, not just what it knows
